text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a letter to her parents, K.S.Miracle 
swore to become the "Fastest of the Era." 
With cheers from her rivals backing her, 
she heads to the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And before the race, facing her swiftest 
rivals, a quiet flame ignited in K.S. 
Miracle's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"My 'miracle' will overtake you." With the 
title of 'Fastest of an Era' on the line, 
K.S. Miracle's Sprinters Stakes was about 
to begin.
